lines.text: The queen of Sheba came to Jerusalem with a large caravan to test Solomon, and he answered all her questions.
She saw Solomon's wisdom, palace, table, servants, and offerings, and it took her breath away.
She said the report was true and blessed the LORD, who made Solomon king to carry out justice and righteousness.
She gave the king 120 talents of silver, a great quantity of spices, and precious stones.
Servants who brought gold from Ophir also brought algum wood, and Solomon made harps from it for the gatekeepers.
